# sauth_user_claim (Resource)

The user_claim records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_id` (String) claim id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `user_id` (String) user id, or the client_id of a machine client

### Optional

- `ends_at` (String) ends at
- `reason` (String) reason
- `starts_at` (String) starts at
